4. Encouraging technology transfer between countries and regions to ensure that innovations that work in one context can be adapted and applied in another.

Overall, technology can play a critical role in addressing the challenges facing farmers, and its benefits can be extended to smallholder farmers in developing countries through targeted investments, partnerships, and capacity-building initiatives.
